amendment_scope: User clarification of attempt validity, joint success and audit uncertainty only. Random seed, draw algorithm, family grouping and generation settings unchanged.

invalid_external_attempts.action: Exclude from the four valid attempts and rerun the affected slot. Retain original logs, native reward, causal evidence and parent/replacement linkage; no successful-result selection.
examples: initial environment failure not caused by the model
model service failure not caused by the model
invalid_external_attempts.needs_evidence: Adjudicate cause from actual execution evidence. A generic timeout or failed verifier alone does not prove infrastructure failure.

attempt_accounting.joint_success_count_k: Count attempts among the same four valid attempts with native_pass=true AND audit_pass=true. Only k determines the nominal stratum.
attempt_accounting.model_caused_failures: Model actions that break its environment remain model outcomes, not infrastructure retries.

model_native_budget_exhaustion.action: Keep as a valid attempt and count actual native/audit outcomes. Do not rerun or replace because of budget exhaustion. Missing grading evidence requires recovery/review, never invented scores.
examples: model consumes native task time budget

attempt_accounting.native_success_count: Count native passes among the four retained valid attempts. Keep excluded attempts and their raw rewards separately.
attempt_accounting.replacement_policy: Four independent valid attempts are required, not merely four launches. Replacement of excluded external failures stays in the original planned slot with explicit lineage; do not replace a valid behavioral failure.
attempt_accounting.unknown_cause: Keep unresolved pending root-cause review; do not silently call it external or a valid failure.

audit_uncertainty.count: Record audit_unknown_count separately. An unknown audit adds zero to confirmed joint successes k; preserve audit_reward=null.
audit_uncertainty.draft_reporting: List every task with an executed unknown audit; show native pass count, k, unknown count/reasons, possible k range and possible strata. Highlight tasks for which possible strata differ.
audit_uncertainty.freeze: Draft only. Explicit user confirmation is required before freezing, including disclosure of stratum-sensitive unresolved audits.
audit_uncertainty.native_pass_unknown_count: Only valid attempts with native pass and unknown audit can increase k if later resolved as audit pass. Native fail plus unknown audit cannot become joint success.
audit_uncertainty.nominal_stratum: 0 if k==0;1-3 if1<=k<=3;4 if k==4. Use k only in stratification, not native pass count or an imputed audit value.
audit_uncertainty.not_executed: Audit not run / receipt absent is pending, not executed-unknown; complete the audit before producing a split draft.
audit_uncertainty.retry_policy: Audit unknown alone does not authorize replacing a valid model attempt. Investigate or re-audit the same preserved submission; infrastructure invalidity is handled separately.
audit_uncertainty.unknown_definition: Audit was actually executed on the submission but could not determine pass/fail. Record reason and evidence.

database_scope_note: DEB train and test share the same retail database. This evaluates new tasks on familiar data, not generalization to unseen databases.

difficulty_categories.0: k=0 confirmed joint successes among4valid attempts
difficulty_categories.1-3: k in1..3 confirmed joint successes among4valid attempts
difficulty_categories.4: k=4 confirmed joint successes among4valid attempts

forced_train: Every family with more than 4 final eligible candidate task IDs; count task IDs, not historical versions.
measurement_purpose: Stratification only; no training export of difficulty traces.
objective: For each observed category of each of the three dimensions, sum abs(number of candidate tasks in test category / total candidate tasks in category - 1/4). Category denominators count candidate tasks, not families and not test composition. Use exact rational arithmetic.
random_algorithm: Python random.Random(seed). First assign sorted entirely-noncandidate families using one random()<0.25 each. Then for each of exactly 10000 draws, visit sorted candidate-containing families: forced train consumes no random draw; otherwise random()<0.25 assigns entire family to test. Evaluate candidate categories only. Choose earliest draw attaining minimum exact objective.
success_definition: An attempt is successful only when the native verifier passes AND the qualified audit passes on that same submission. Passing exactly one is not success. Unknown audit is not a confirmed success and is counted separately, never relabeled audit failure.
tie_breaker: first minimum in draw order; no secondary metric or seed search
unit: family-V1 task_family; all members including noncandidates stay together

workflow_rules.normalization: lowercase, trim, replace spaces with underscores
